rule: display_only iff every writer and every reader of the byte in load_tail/between_frames/frame1 runs inside a display root call or is a declared DirectDraw handler; everything else is game logic
method: Original only.  Input: the committed display-scenario reference (``exibicao`` -v2 captures).  For every byte that changes in phase (a) load_tail, (b) between_frames or (c) frame1 (state after the phase vs before it), the scenario is rerun natively with Unicorn read and write hooks on exactly those bytes (ranges widened by 3 bytes, filtered per byte; translation cache flushed) plus the declared surface region, and every access is attributed:
